name: Supercam S350
characteristics: Strength: Longer comms range (100-120km) than the Zala Z-16 in the same general weight class
Limitation: No stated counter-drone evasion mechanisms, unlike some competing types in the same catalog
Estimated quantity available: Fleet size not disclosed
employment_notes: Represents a separate Russian manufacturer/product line from Zala and Orlan, indicating a fragmented rather than single-standardized Russian tactical drone industrial base
contrast_vs_traditional: Supercam fills the same persistent tactical-reconnaissance niche as Zala Z-16 — cheap enough and simple enough to fly repeatedly over a sector, which is precisely the pattern doctrine.md describes letting both sides map enemy positions over 2–7 days rather than through any single high-value reconnaissance sortie.

sources.label: Army Recognition — Russia unveils Supercam S350
